recognize_zh: A 圖雙小腿皮膚發紅、緊繃發亮並有大型結痂潰瘍；B 圖胸肩部色素沉著與色素脫失交錯的斑駁外觀；C 圖手臂皮膚緊繃並見沿靜脈走向的凹溝（箭頭，groove sign）與肘關節攣縮（大箭頭），皆為硬皮病樣（sclerodermatous）慢性移植物抗宿主病的表現。
features: A: shiny, erythematous, bound-down skin of both lower legs with large crusted ulcers and scattered erosions
B: mottled hyperpigmented and hypopigmented (depigmented) patches over the upper chest and shoulders
C: taut skin of the arm with linear depressions along superficial veins (groove sign, small arrows)
C: restricted elbow extension suggesting joint contracture from fasciitis (large arrowhead)
describe_en: Composite clinical photographs of sclerotic chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panel A shows shiny, erythematous, indurated skin of both lower legs with large crusted ulcers, typical of deep sclerosis prone to breakdown. Panel B shows a mottled pattern of hyperpigmentation and depigmentation over the upper chest and shoulders. Panel C shows taut skin of the upper extremity with linear depressions along superficial veins (groove sign, arrows) and limited elbow extension (arrowhead), consistent with fasciitis and joint contracture. Sclerotic features, morphea-like lesions and fasciitis are diagnostic manifestations of chronic GVHD by NIH criteria.

ddx.vs: Systemic sclerosis typically begins with Raynaud phenomenon and acral sclerodactyly with specific autoantibodies (anti-Scl-70, anticentromere), without a history of allogeneic transplantation.
Eosinophilic fasciitis also shows the groove sign but spares hands/face, shows peripheral eosinophilia and fascial eosinophils, and occurs without transplantation.
Idiopathic morphea forms circumscribed ivory plaques with a lilac border, without extensive multifocal involvement, ulceration or other organ cGVHD features.
NSF occurs in renal failure after gadolinium exposure and involves the extremities with CD34-positive fibrocytes on biopsy.
